document: Consolidated Unresolved Engineering Dependencies & Open Items

unresolved_items.item: Section 5.8 — Equivalent bar size for grouped/bundled bars
unresolved_items.status: PARTIALLY RESOLVED: formula bn = ø*sqrt(nb) <= 55mm recovered from Section 5.4.5; Section 5.8 text itself remains unresolved.

unresolved_items.item: Section 5.15 — Secondary beam lever arm check when top cover is increased
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: referenced at Section 4.2.2 note 3; detailing consequence is effective depth z = d - x/2 check.

unresolved_items.item: Section 5.1.3(1)P UK National Annex — single load case all-spans-loaded condition for simplified curtailment
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: referenced in Section 6.2.2; external to manual (EC2 UK NA).

unresolved_items.item: Model Details MS2A, MS2B, MS2C — slab-to-wall moment connection full geometry
unresolved_items.status: RESOLVED: Section 6.5 (Walls: MW1-MW4, Rule W24) and Section 6.2.2 confirm MS2 edge-wall connections, MW3 pre-bent starter U-bars (Class B/C steel, size <= 12, two fixing bars inside U-bars, tension lap) and kicker 75/150 details.

unresolved_items.item: Model Details MF1 and MF2 — column starter bars from pad footings and pile caps
unresolved_items.status: RESOLVED: Section 6.7 (Foundations: MF1, MF2, Rules F07, F10, F17, F18) provides starter bar minimum horizontal leg 450mm, compression lap + 150mm level tolerance, 3 No. min H10-300 column links, 75mm cover, kicker 75 (150 below ground).

unresolved_items.item: EC2 Table 3.2 — fctm values by concrete grade
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: referenced in Section 6.9.2 As,min formula; EC2 material properties table.

unresolved_items.item: Good / poor bond condition full definitions (§5.4)

unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: referenced in corbel notes '(see also 5.6)'.

unresolved_items.item: Staircase MST2 fragment overall geometry (rise / going / flight span)
unresolved_items.status: RESOLVED: Section 6.8 (Staircases: MST1, MST2, Fig 6.33, Rules S01-S11) provides flight geometry (going, rise, waist thickness, run, slope length), landing top U-bar extension A = max(0.1*span, lbd, 500), 50% As bottom, and MST2 cantilever rules (nominal H8 U-bar, H8@300 links, H10@300 distribution, tension anchorage into wall).

unresolved_items.item: Prestressed tendons minimum radius of curvature at deviation zones and anchorage cover
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: defers to BS EN 10138 and European Technical Approvals (ETA).

unresolved_items.item: Prestressed Fig 7.4 / Fig 7.5 exact governing minimum spacing numbers
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: OCR numbers partially garbled in original figure; formulas preserved with caution flag.

unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: printed as 'T = C - P/16' with 3/4P, P/16, P/4 labels; exact fractional placement OCR-uncertain.

unresolved_items.item: Wall internal cover: Section 6.5.2 vs MW1 drawing standard
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED/NOTED CONFLICT: Section 6.5.2 gives max(15, bar dia)+dcdev, whereas MW1 notes state 'at least 20 or bar size' and Section 6.5.3 gives 20mm. Detailing drawing convention standard 20mm adopted.

unresolved_items.item: Retaining wall cover: Section 6.6.2 vs MRW1/MRW2 drawing standard
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED/NOTED CONFLICT: Section 6.6.2 gives internal max(20, bar dia)+dcdev and earth 45+dcdev; Section 6.6.3 and MRW1/MRW2 standard details show 25 internal, 50 earth. Standard drawing values used.

unresolved_items.item: Poor-bond anchorage factor discrepancy between Table 6.9 (Foundations) and Table 6.11 (Stairs)
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED/NOTED CONFLICT: Table 6.9 gives 48/45/43/41 for poor bond, whereas Table 6.11 gives 58/53/51/49 for the exact same steel and poor bond condition (ratio ~1/0.7 suggests Table 6.11 may be more accurate). Preserved verbatim from each table.

unresolved_items.item: Foundation bar spacing unheaded categories in Section 6.7.2
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: Section 6.7.2 lists max 200, then 'minimum 100' and 'max 300/225/175 by Ast' without element headers (likely distinguishing ground slabs vs pad/pile caps).

unresolved_items.item: Table 6.10 5-pile cap bar shape/size OCR pairing
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED: Row layout in scan is partially garbled; 5-pile bar shape codes uncertain.

unresolved_items.item: MW1 table thickness row overlap convention (e.g. 200mm in 175-200 and 200-250)
unresolved_items.status: UNRESOLVED/CONVENTION: Boundary thicknesses sit in two rows. System adopts lower row match (e.g. 200mm -> 175-200mm row).
